transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I came in because... well, nothing feels like mine anymore. I don't know how else to put it. I used to get excited about things, you know? Painting murals, going for runs, playing basketball. Even just making a good drink at work. Now I just stand there, and I don't care about any of it. It's just gone.
Have you ever had a period when you felt unusually energized or wired, much more than your normal self?
No, not really. I've never had a time where I felt wired or anything like that. Just... tired, mostly.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?

Yeah, pretty much every day. I just wake up and... I don't know, it's just a heavy feeling. Like I said, mostly I just feel tired and empty. So, yeah, I've definitely been feeling down. It just doesn't really go away.
Have you been feeling this way continuously for two years or more?

No, it hasn't been two years. It's been... about two months now. It started right after the bar I work at got bought out. They came in and changed everything I had been working toward, and since then... yeah, it's just been like this.
Do these feelings seem stronger than you would expect just from what happened at work?

I don't know... maybe? I mean, I was pretty upset about the changes at the bar, but I guess I didn't think it would hit me this hard for this long. It's just... it's really heavy. So, yeah, maybe it is stronger than it should be.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of harming yourself?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I feel miserable, but... I don't want to die or anything. I've never thought about hurting myself. It's just more of that heavy, tired feeling I mentioned, not... not wanting to end things.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge a lot lately?
No, not really. I mean, I wouldn't say I feel anxious or on edge. It's more just... like I said, that heavy, tired feeling. I don't feel nervous or jumpy, just sort of weighed down by everything.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?

Yeah, definitely. Most days I just... I forget to eat entirely. I don't even realize it until my hands start shaking while I'm working behind the bar. Then I might try to grab a few bites of something cold after closing, but I honestly just feel sick even looking at it. So yeah, I'm really not eating much at all.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or take care of things you normally manage?

Yeah, it has. I've actually missed a few shifts recently, which isn't like me. And when I am there, I've been making mistakes at closing—things I never used to mess up. Now the other bartenders have to double-check my work, and they used to completely trust me to handle it. Outside of work, it's the same. I used to go running with friends, play basketball, or go shoot photos of murals around the city, but I just... I stopped doing all of it. I just can't bring myself to show up anymore.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

Yeah, sleep has been pretty rough. I'll lie down at night, and I'm exhausted, but my head just won't shut off. I just keep going over every single mistake I made during my shift... just playing it on a loop. And then, when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I'm wide awake by four or five in the morning. Once I'm up, that's it. I can't get back to sleep at all.
Even when you’re not thinking about what changed at the bar, do you still feel down?

Yeah, pretty much. It's not just about the bar. I mean... even if I'm just sitting around the apartment not doing anything, I still feel it. It's just this constant, heavy feeling. It doesn't really matter what's on my mind, honestly... I just feel down all the time.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking about how I let down the younger bartenders. And there were these artists I promised to give space to at the bar, and I dropped the ball on that, too. I feel like I completely wrecked their shot. Honestly, it just makes me feel like I deserve whatever happens to me now for messing things up for them.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah, it's been a real struggle. I mean, doing inventory used to be completely automatic for me. I could do it in my sleep. But lately... I just stand there staring at the bottles, and I'll lose count two or three times. It's frustrating. And it's not just the numbers. Even simple things, like... trying to decide which garnish to restock first. I just freeze up. I can't seem to hold onto a thought long enough to actually make a decision.
Have you lost weight lately without trying to?

Yeah, I have. Most days I honestly just forget to eat. I don't even realize it until I'm behind the bar and my hands start shaking. Then, maybe after closing, I'll try to grab a few bites of something cold, but... I just feel sick even looking at it. So, yeah, I've definitely lost some weight.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking noticeably slower lately?

No, I don't think so. No one's said anything to me about moving slower or talking different, anyway. I feel pretty much the same physically, just... tired. But nobody's pointed anything like that out to me.
Before the bar changed hands, were you already feeling depressed?

No, not at all. Before the new owners took over and I... sank into this whole thing, I never felt like this. And I definitely never had these thoughts about ruining the place or... or that people were being punished because of me. All of that, those thoughts, they only really started happening after I got depressed these past couple of months.
